layer_at_fault_line: Nothing in this report is contradicted by anything available to a blind marker holding only the report itself, so no fault is attributed to any layer.
quotes: marks_per_part cells excluded for carrying two different marks: B — "**Loose** on the exact numbers, **held** on the qualitative point"; D — "**Borrowed**, and **held if**"; E — "**Idle** for the core trilemma; **borrowed** as color"; F — "**Unknown / loose**". pairs_that_pull excluded because neither side is a report part label: "Pf and f_I trade off against each other — a high Pf can be offset by a very low f_I to avoid (3), and vice versa — but the paper never closes this space, which is exactly why F is unsupported." rivals_built excluded because the rival is only named, not built with a distinguishing change or a plain no-change-can statement: "the paper itself builds and dismisses one rival (the Doomsday argument's stronger sampling assumption) — a genuine self-test, done well."
